subject: Refund ke naam pe UPI collect request - Rs 3998 gaya
text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Main Sunil More, Sahyadri Bank Mumbai ka account holder. 29 Aug Saturday dopahar ko QuickCart ke ek order ka refund lene ke liye maine internet pe customer care number search kiya tha. Jo banda phone pe tha usne bola aapko ek request aayegi usko approve karo to refund aa jayega. Maine UPI collect request approve kiya aur PIN daala, 1999 kat gaya. Usne bola galat ho gaya dobara approve karo, phir se 1999 kat gaya. Total 3998. Paisa arvindsolanki6025@ivbupi pe gaya hai, statement me dikh raha hai. Uska number ab mere paas nahi hai, call log se delete ho gaya.

Kripya paisa wapas dilaye aur us account ko band karaye. 2 raat se neend nahi aayi.

Regards
Sunil More

subject: Walk-in: online task job fraud Rs 73,000
text: Cx walked in at Navrangpura br near closing, very upset, came alone. Student, final yr. Says she got WhatsApp msg from +91 52669 28437 offering Rs 150 per video like. Was added to a Telegram group, got 2-3 small payouts. Then told to do 'merchant tasks' by paying first. Paid 8,000 on 14 Sep, 25,000 on 15 Sep and 40,000 today afternoon to globaldigitals5313@wgcbupi. Total 73,000 - part of it her fees money. Now they are asking 'withdrawal fee'. Requested bank not to contact her parents. Advised 1930, helped her start NCRP registration on her phone. Written complaint taken, SR raised.
